question: Do the closed-form finite-information-interface results in THEORY.md agree with independent exact brute-force enumeration on bounded universes?
unrestricted_claim_source: Proofs in THEORY.md for arbitrary finite nonempty state/action sets, positive weights, and real losses.
predictions: Closed-form partition risk equals brute-force deterministic policy risk.
Zero information regret is equivalent to a common optimum on every positive-weight fibre.
Every same-fibre pair lower bound is no larger than global regret.
Every checked refinement weakly lowers optimal risk.
No denominator-3 randomized policy probe beats the deterministic fibre optimum.
Weighted 0-1 risk equals fibre minority mass.
Scalar minimax point radius equals half fibre diameter and covering interval width equals fibre diameter.
exclusions: No substitution of bounded regression for unrestricted proof.
